v. 结结巴巴地说

n a speech disorder involving hesitations and involuntary repetitions of certain sounds
v speak haltingly
stuttered: v. 结结巴巴地说( stutter的过去式和过去分词 ); 不顺畅的工作, 时断时续地移动
stutterer: n. 口吃者, 说话结巴者
n someone who speaks with involuntary pauses and repetitions
stutterers: (stutterer 的复数) n. 口吃者, 说话结巴者
stuttering:
n. 口吃, 结巴
[医] 口吃, 讷吃
stutterings:
(stuttering 的复数) n. 口吃, 结巴
[医] 口吃, 讷吃
stutters: v. 结结巴巴地说( stutter的第三人称单数 ); 不顺畅的工作, 时断时续地移动
stuttgart: n. 斯图加特（德国城市）
n. a city in southwestern Germany famous for innovative architecture
